name: - RFB
fix_description: randMod uses on-chain public data (block.number, block.timestamp, buyer address, pair balance) as randomness source. An attacker contract can pre-compute the result and only execute when the lottery condition is met. Use Chainlink VRF or commit-reveal scheme for unpredictable randomness.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short flash-loan-funded buy/sell loop against a likely vulnerable fee-on-transfer token, with only a few protocol interactions: borrow WBNB, swap BNB->token, swap token->BNB, and repay. Although it uses a flash loan and a small brute-force loop to find a profitable amount, the exploit logic is straightforward and does not require deep protocol-specific reasoning.
